_about: Skills the Warden can learn from a trainer for coins. `craft`: a skill with recipes (recipes.json) names its crafting window, the verb in the log, its button and where you must stand. `teaches`: abilities that appear in the spellbook once learned. `maxRank`: skills that improve with use (fishing rises with each catch, cooking with each dish that is not yet easy for you). `train` (a skill on the profession ladder): the trainer ranks past Novice, each { rank, trainer, cost, level (skill level needed), quest? (must be done) }. A laddered skill runs from 1 to 60 and its trainer rank caps it (`ladder.ranks`); it rises by skill experience, earned by the colour of the task (`ladder.actionXp`), and each level-up pays `ladder.charXpShare` of a character level's experience. `perks`: at each listed skill level you choose one of two; `effect` keys are read by the profession's system.

skills.name: Camping
skills.desc: Pitch a camp anywhere quiet. Your spirit rises there if you fall, resting by it builds rested experience, and Return to Camp brings you back to it.

skills.name: Fishing
skills.desc: Cast a line into still water and strike when the bob dips. Every water has a level: you need that much Fishing to fish it, and it teaches you less once it is easy. Better rods need more skill to use.

choices.name: Steady Hands
choices.desc: +10% chance to land a fish when you strike.

choices.name: Double Haul
choices.desc: 15% chance to land two fish at once.

choices.name: Deep Lure
choices.desc: Rare fish bite twice as often.

skills.name: Lockpicking
skills.desc: Open locked chests without their key (you need lockpicks). Each lock needs a certain rank; every lock you pick raises it.

skills.name: Cooking
skills.desc: Cook fish and meat at a fire (a camp or the inn's hearth). Grilled perch and roast dace come with the skill; Hester teaches more as you improve. Rises as you cook.

craft.station: a fire: your camp or a hearth

skills.name: Herbalism
skills.desc: Pick the herbs that grow wild across the land. Each herb has a level: you need that much Herbalism to pick it, and the best grow in dangerous places. Herbs move: a picked patch is gone, and another springs up nearby. A knife or sickle in your bags makes you quicker.

choices.name: Green Thumb
choices.desc: 25% chance to pick an extra herb.

choices.name: Rootcutter
choices.desc: Twice the chance of a herb's rare find (seeds, roots, the odd lost trinket).

choices.name: Healer's Touch
choices.desc: Picking a herb heals you for 4% of your health.

skills.name: Alchemy
skills.desc: Brew herbs into draughts and elixirs at an alchemy bench. Draughts heal at once; an elixir raises a stat for a while (one elixir at a time). Briony teaches more recipes as you improve.

choices.name: Careful Measure
choices.desc: 15% chance to brew two from one set of herbs.

choices.name: The Last Drop
choices.desc: 10% chance a draught or elixir is not used up when you drink it.

skills.name: Skinning
skills.desc: Skin the beasts you kill for their hides and pelts (you need a skinning knife). Loot the body first, then skin it. Higher-level beasts need a higher rank (5 ranks a level); the skill rises with every skin that is not yet easy for you.

skills.name: Mining
skills.desc: Mine the ore veins that glint in rock outcrops (you need a mining pick), and smelt ore into bars at a forge. Veins move: a mined-out outcrop goes bare and another in the same group starts to glint. Harder rock needs a higher rank (5 ranks an ore level); the skill rises with every swing that is not yet easy for you, and as you smelt.

ladder._about: The profession ladder (game/systems/skills.gd). Ranks cap the skill; a level needs xpBase + xpPerLevel x level skill experience. A task's colour comes from how far your skill is over the level it needs: under bands[0] orange, under bands[1] yellow, under bands[2] green, past that grey (nothing to learn). Each skill level-up gives charXpShare of a character level's experience at that level.
